QuestInfo.name: The First Big Case
QuestInfo.0: Farasi has some good news for you: you've got your first official case as an independent private investigator!
QuestInfo.1: After days of unrewarding small-time work, something resembling a real case has finally come your way. Go to #r#m410000201##k and meet #b#p3001604##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've received your first official case from Kaling. It sounds like it involves not only theft, but a missing person too.
